assertions.evidence: Both subjects launched as role 'curator' (consumes feature:none, plan:none) wearing only the generic identity. Each persisted harness_shared.adv_sessions.launch_spec (rows 31431, 31432) has exactly the keys harnessSlug, role, specificationArtifact, specificationRevision, stack, stateRevision, v, workspaceId: no work-item, fleet, goal or launch-slot field. Launch was not refused for lacking SU fields.

snapshot.sh captures the launcher SU's control_state (modes, route, scope, stack), its agent_modes, its coord_presence role/fleet/fleetRole, the fleet r7-journey-0927 member list, the workspace operator_quota_overrides and the recipe row count. For the independent launch, pre-indep and post-indep snapshots are identical apart from their capture time. For the fleet-inherited launch, the only differences are the subject joining the fleet roster (from the launcher's own --fleet flag) and the bundled recipe row (0 -> 1); the launcher's control state, modes, presence and quota overrides are unchanged.

A second turn reached the independent subject at 2026-09-29T09:27:22.396Z (turn origin wake-pump, inbox-wake for message P008_J2R_S2). Its native transcript records two UserPromptSubmit hook_additional_context attachments on that turn: a turn-provenance stamp (09:27:22.448Z) and a 13,815-byte block (09:27:23.266Z) carrying a fresh '## Orientation' section and a '## Relevant memory (turn-start delta)' section. The Orientation block lists only other sessions' directives (FYI rows); it carries no work-item claim, loop, fleet or launch-slot assignment for the subject. The WI- ids that appear are citations inside memory excerpts. No CTRL block was emitted on this turn because the subject's control state did not change. The observation is read from the transcript by .papercusp/scratch/p008-j2r/scan-turn-context.mjs, not from the subject's self-report. The subject could not read the P008_J2R_S2 body because curator lacks coord:read, which is the L7 property.

Neither launch command passes --model. The compiled configuration carries knobs.aiBackend.default.model = claude-opus-4-8 from the identity (preflight.json). Every assistant message in both subject transcripts records message.model = claude-opus-4-8: 10 messages for su-9beaa821 and 14 for su-a4163faf, with no other model.

The recipe row count for p008-j2r-generic-recipe was 0 before the first launch and 1 after it: launch provisioning wrote the bundled recipe into harness_shared.code_recipes (authorRole blueprint-bundle). The prompt does not name the recipe (preflight promptMentionsRecipe=false). Both subjects retrieved it with recipes:get (ok=true, script text returned), and the independent subject ran it with recipes:run (ok=true, summary 'from p008 j2r generic identity').

The generic identity declares no workflow graph. Both subjects launched, and their transcripts show the model choosing its own tool calls turn by turn: coord:whoami, recipes:get and coord:send for su-9beaa821; recipes:get and recipes:run on turn 1 and coord:inbox then orders:get on turn 2 for su-a4163faf. No workflow runner or graph dispatch appears.

The fleet-inherited subject's coord:whoami and coord:send were refused server-side with 'missing_capability: Principal "system:curator" lacks capability "coord:read"' and '... "coord:write"'. The independent subject's coord:inbox and orders:get were refused with the same coord:read refusal. The composed identity carried no SU grant: the sessions kept the curator principal.

commandBasis: Launch request bodies are the launch-args JSON files; launch responses are launch-result.json and launch-indep-result.json. Subject observations come from each subject's native transcript (parse-transcript.mjs for tool calls/results, scan-turn-context.mjs for injected turn-start context). Launch-spec keys come from harness_shared.adv_sessions rows 31431/31432.
notProven: R-5 coverage is limited to the resource kinds this identity bundles: a callable recipe and a model default. Tool/provider requirements, rubrics, knowledge, and plan/goal/datatype/event/rule resources were not bundled, so they were not driven live here. Their tree-plane coverage is the integration/unit/mutation bindings on AUTO-BAR-R-5-P-008@3.
'History' and 'addressing' preservation from R-10 were not snapshotted directly. The snapshot covers the launcher's control state, modes, presence, fleet roster, quota overrides and recipe rows.
The subject role was curator, not worker: worker consumes feature:required, and psu refuses to launch it without a feature. A feature-bound role would contradict the no-work-item-state requirement.
No event_wake_deliveries row was found for the turn-2 wake by subscriber id; the delivery is evidenced by the subject transcript's wake-pump-origin turn at 09:27:22Z.
summary: Two headless Claude subjects launched on :3170 (build c6d3f7ed44, current role-launch-spec.ts and psu-launcher.mjs blobs) as role curator wearing only the installed generic identity p008-j2r-generic-domain. Their persisted launch specs carry no work-item, fleet or launch-slot fields. The independent launch changed nothing in the launcher SU's state, quotas or fleet; the fleet-inherited launch changed only the fleet roster (the launcher's own --fleet flag) and provisioned the bundled recipe. Without --model, the identity's bundled default claude-opus-4-8 was the model on all 24 assistant messages. The bundled recipe reached harness_shared.code_recipes and was callable via recipes:get and recipes:run from the agent's own ReAct loop; no workflow graph was declared. A second turn refreshed the subject's Orientation and memory context with no SU assignment fields. The curator principal was refused coord:read and coord:write, so composing the identity granted no SU capability.
timeBasis: UTC throughout; snapshot 'at' fields come from Postgres now(); launch times come from launch-started-at files; turn and hook times come from subject transcript timestamps.
